title: The Price You Pay for Passion
why_read: A personal reflective blog post about passion and burnout in tech with no technical content to offer engineers.
analysis: This is a casual, first-person essay about the author's enthusiasm for technology and coping with career setbacks like a rejected conference talk. It contains no technical substance, code, architecture discussion, or research findings. It reads as part of a lifestyle or community blogging series rather than engineering content. It would not serve readers looking for technical substance in a digest.
